interface.comparison: stdout compared exactly after removing one terminal LF or CRLF from each string; preserve all other whitespace. Exit code compared exactly.
interface.calculator_output_convention: Plain decimal notation; omit unnecessary leading/trailing zeros and decimal point for integers; append one newline. Use round-half-even when a significant-digit limit applies.
interface.invalid_input_convention:
For a requested generic error response use Error: invalid input
 and exit 1, unless the customer specifies otherwise.
